events.title: Breakfast with Santa
events.address: Quinlan Community Center, 10185 North Stelling Road, 95014
events.description: You and your family are invited to a festive breakfast celebration with Santa! Enjoy delicious North Pole pancakes prepared by Santa's elves, take photos with Santa, and explore a holiday workshop filled with crafts and activities for children. Three seatings: 8:30 a.m., 9:30 a.m., 10:30 a.m. Registration opens in late July.
events.blurb: Eat North Pole pancakes, snap photos with Santa, and make holiday crafts with your family.

events.title: San José Roots
events.address: 87 N San Pedro St., San José
events.description: A free, family-friendly festival celebrating San Jose's indigenous, Spanish, Mexican, and multicultural history, kicking off the city's 250th anniversary with hands-on activities, historic home tours, local art, and cultural performances.
events.blurb: Tour the historic adobe homes, join in hands-on activities, and catch local art and cultural performances marking San Jose's 250th.
